error.versionRejected: Server rejected the cli version ({version}) — please update.
error.sessionReplaced: Another session for this profile took over — this instance is stopping. (Are you running `4pm start` twice for the same profile?)
error.accountPaused: This account is paused — retrying until it is resumed.
error.linkInvalid: Link is no longer valid ({reason}) — deleted .cre. Run `4pm link` to pair again.
start.notLinked: Profile "{profile}" is not linked — run `4pm link --server <URL>` first.
start.updateBlocked: CLI is older than minSupported ({minSupported}) and the update failed — cannot connect.
start.alreadyRunning: Profile "{profile}" is already running (pid {pid}). Only one `4pm start` per profile is allowed.
attach.noDaemon: No running daemon for profile "{profile}". Start it first: 4pm start --profile {profile}
update.cannotReach: Could not reach the server at {url} — is it running? Set the server with `--server <url>` or the FOURPM_SERVER env var.
aiLogin.launchFailed: ✖ Could not launch `{cmd}` — is it installed? ({message})
error.noLinkedProfile: No linked profile — run `4pm link` first.
error.multipleProfiles: Multiple profiles — pass --profile <name> (or run `4pm {action}` in a terminal to pick).
link.step1: 1. Open the 4PM web → /machines, enter the pairing code:
link.step2: 2. The web will show a confirmation code — paste it here.
link.saved: ✔ {verb} profile "{profile}" as "{username}" · scope: {scope} — saved .cre. Run `4pm start` to connect.
link.orchestratorNote: (This is the orchestrator/admin link. To pair a worker instead, pick the MACHINE user in the web pairing wizard before entering the pairing code.)
unlink.revokeFailed: ⚠ Could not reach the server to revoke — revoke it at web /machines. ({message})
unlink.deleted: ✔ Deleted the profile and its physic project folder.
version.fetchFailed: Could not reach the server for the latest version: {error}
aiLogin.noProfiles: Profile "{profile}" has no usable AI profiles configured — add one in the web Worker configs or config.json.
aiLogin.skipping: - Skipping {provider} "{profile}" — no known credential dir for this provider.
aiLogin.completeSignIn: Complete the provider's own sign-in (claude: type `/login`; codex: follow its prompt), then exit.
aiLogin.tip: Tip: for the credentials to survive `docker rm`/recreate, keep each profile path under the mounted volume (e.g. `~/.4pm/ai/<name>`) — ADR-0199.
update.devBuild: Running a local dev build ({version}) — update it by rebuilding the repo (`pnpm --filter @4pm/cli build`), not `4pm update`.
update.updated: ✔ Updated to {version}. Run `4pm start` to reconnect.
update.notApplied: Update reported success but the installed version is still {installed} (expected {expected}) — it did not apply to the running install (check the global npm prefix vs the running binary).
update.scheduledChecking: Scheduled auto-update: checking for a new version…
session.stoppedPrompts: Session stopped — restart 4pm to run prompts.
session.reconnectingPrompt: Not connected — reconnecting before running the prompt…
session.stillNotConnected: Still not connected — run /reconnect then try again.
session.noProjectDir: No project attached — running in the current directory.
session.daemonDisconnected: Daemon disconnected — the worker process closed the control channel.
update.newVersionAutoUpdateOff: A new version {latest} is available (running {current}) — autoUpdate is off.
history.noStorage: Command history: no storage provider (HISTORY_STORAGE) — stored locally only.
tui.inputHint: /help · Tab complete · ↑↓ history · PgUp/PgDn scroll · Ctrl+C quit
slash.desc.history: List the last N executed commands (+ time)
slash.desc.expand: Expand a collapsed ▸[N] block (default: newest); pretty-prints json/code
slash.desc.reconnect: Reconnect to the server now (skip the backoff)
slash.desc.whoami: Show this machine account + its teams & projects
slash.desc.aiProfile: List AI profiles / switch which one runs (ADR-0250)
slash.desc.config: View / init / update / delete profile config
slash.config.addClaudeHint: add claude profiles: /config set claudeHome .claude .claude-1 (tried in order)
slash.config.replaceConfirm: config exists: {path} — replace it with defaults? (y/N)
slash.config.unknownSub: Unknown /config subcommand "{sub}". Use: show | init | set | delete.
slash.history.header: Last {n} of {total} commands (newest first) · /output <n> to view:
slash.output.none: (no output stored — it ran in a previous session or produced none)
slash.whoami.unavailable: whoami: unavailable (server unreachable or link invalid)
slash.aiProfile.none: No AI profiles configured (config.aiProfiles is empty).
slash.aiProfile.legacyHint: This worker may use a legacy per-provider config — /config show to inspect.
slash.aiProfile.listHeader: AI profiles (config order = failover priority) · /ai-profile use <n> to switch:
slash.aiProfile.pinnedNote: A profile is pinned — tried first every prompt; /ai-profile reset returns to auto.
slash.aiProfile.resetOk: ✔ AI profile pin cleared — failover is back to automatic (config order / remembered).
slash.aiProfile.whyNoProfile: it has no usable profile dir / provider
slash.aiProfile.switchedOk: ✔ switched to {provider} profile "{label}" — tried first from the next prompt (failover keeps the rest as backup).
slash.aiProfile.unknownSub: Unknown /ai-profile subcommand "{sub}". Use: list | use <n> | reset.
start.recovered: Recovered from an internal error — reconnecting: {message}
attach.attached: Attached to profile "{profile}" — the worker runs headless; input is forwarded.
autoRun.noDaemon: No running daemon for profile "{profile}" — start it first: 4pm start --profile {profile}
autoRun.timeout: Autonomous cycle exceeded the time limit — aborting.
autoRun.authFailed: Control-channel authentication failed — the daemon rejected the token.
